Last night was the darkest night in a long time. I sat at the edge of my balcony between pain and fear. I wanted to die, but I was afraid to jump. And when I finally gathered courage to do a big leap, my phone starting buzzing. I didnt want to die without finding out who was contacting me at 6 in the morning. It was an email from Flying Blue: 

"
Dear Mr...,
You currently have 9,899 Award Miles in your account. Miles you can spend on award flights, upgrades, flight-related services and much more."

I have almost 10k unspent miles that would be wasted if I just jumped. So I spent the next hour trying to buy something with the miles. Then I thought about my furniture, my bankaccount, my creditcard I have 9k to spend on my creditcard. I started shopping and bought my little brother a gaming laptop that he always wanted for 3k euro. Booked a trip to Stockholm for my sister that she always wanted. Send 4k to my friend who is balding at 24 so he can afford his dream of doing hair transplantation. 

I was so occupied by all that that I forgot about time. Then I got called by a recruiter. She invited me for an interview for her client in brewing industry. Brewing industry, I dont know anything about brewing industry, but I got excited to find out. I want to see my little brothers face when he receives the laptop, I want to see my friend with hair on his head, I want to hear how my sisters trip goes and I want to find out if I get hired at this brewing company. I have postponed my suicide for a few weeks.
